title: haxfinity
description: 12–13 December 2026 10:30 AM, 12 December – 10:30 AM, 13 December Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur, Kerala Prizes:Exciting prizes — details to be announced Team size:2–4 participants Participation: Free Build real solutions, solve meaningful problems, and create something that works. HAXFINITY is a 24-hour hackathon conducted as part of XTHRON ’26, the annual IT fest of the Department of Computer Science, Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous), Nilambur. Students from different colleges and backgrounds will identify problems, build software prototypes, and present their work to judges. The event includes the opening ceremony, a 21-hour project-building window, demonstrations, judging, and awards. There is no compulsory theme. Teams may choose any problem and build a software solution using any suitable technology. Build a product, tool, or prototype that solves a real problem or explores an idea. Build an application using machine learning, generative AI, NLP, computer vision, data analysis, or another AI-related technology. Build technology that improves people’s lives — for example, in education, healthcare, accessibility, sustainability, financial inclusion, or community welfare. Detailed judging criteria will be published before the event. Building window:*11:00 AM, 12 December – 8:00 AM, 13 December (21 hours). Students from all colleges, streams, and experience levels are welcome. You can participate as a beginner, developer, designer, or creative problem-solver. Interests in AI, cybersecurity, web, mobile, cloud, or social-impact technology are all welcome. Amal College of Advanced Studies (Autonomous) Santhigramam, Eranhimangad Nilambur, Malappuram, Kerala — 679329 Check-in and travel details will be shared with registered participants. Opportunity to demo projects to judges Competition Rules All project-specific development must happen during the official building window. Teams may arrive with an idea, but pre-built projects cannot be submitted. Open-source libraries, APIs, datasets, and templates are allowed, subject to their licences. Teams must disclose pre-existing components and AI tools used. Generative AI and AI-assisted development tools are allowed across all tracks. Teams should submit early; late submissions may not be accepted. A working prototype or meaningful demonstration is expected. Teams must be able to explain their technology, process, third-party components, and contributions. Projects must not violate copyright, privacy, security, or applicable law. Organisers may disqualify entries for plagiarism, misconduct, unsafe content, or rule violations. All participants are expected to maintain a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming environment. Participants can approach the organising team for assistance or to report a concern. title: CODERAVE 2.0
description: CODE • COLLABORATE • INNOVATE - The SLIET Annual Hackathon. Organized by Internwell SLIET Club Venue: Sant Longowal Institute of Engineering and Technology (SLIET), Longowal, Punjab Mode: Hybrid — Online (All India) + Offline (SLIET Campus) Coderave 2.0 is a national-level hybrid hackathon designed to bring together innovative minds, passionate developers, designers, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful technology solutions. Organized by Internwell SLIET Club, this edition offers students an opportunity to demonstrate their creativity, technical expertise, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities through a competitive, time-bound development experience. The hackathon welcomes teams from colleges and universities across India through its online participation track, while SLIET students can participate in the offline campus track. Shortlisted teams will present their ideas through PPT pitches, followed by an intensive 24-hour open-source development challenge in which participants will build, test, and demonstrate their solutions. Whether you are interested in web development, app development, artificial intelligence, cybersecurity, data science, or other emerging technologies, Coderave 2.0 is your platform to innovate, collaborate, and compete. Round 1 — Registration and PPT Submission: The Team Leader registers the complete team and submits the project proposal PPT. Round 2 — PPT Evaluation and Shortlisting: Judges evaluate submissions based on innovation, problem relevance, feasibility, technical approach, potential impact, and presentation quality. Round 3 — PPT Pitch: Shortlisted online teams(Max 20 team) pitch through an online meeting. Shortlisted SLIET teams pitch offline on campus on 13 February. Round 4 — 24-Hour Open-Source Hackathon: Selected teams(Both online and offline track) build their solutions within the official development window. Round 5 — Final Submission and Evaluation: Teams submit their working solution, source code repository, demo video, and other required deliverables. Judges evaluate the final projects and announce the winners. The hackathon is an opportunity to turn ideas into functional prototypes within 24 hours. Teams are expected to develop their solutions during the official event window and use open-source tools, libraries, and technologies wherever possible. Participants must maintain a project repository, provide clear documentation, and ensure that their work is demonstrable. Teams must disclose third-party components and follow applicable open-source licences. Previously developed work must be declared, and the core solution must comply with the organizers' originality requirements. Exciting prizes, goodies, certificates, and recognition await outstanding teams. Final awards, prize amounts, sponsor benefits, and certificate eligibility will be announced through the official event communication. Note: The dates above are tentative until officially confirmed. The year, registration deadline, online pitch schedule, and final evaluation schedule will be published by the organizers. Bring your idea, build your team, and turn innovation into impact. Register for Coderave 2.0 and take your first step toward creating something extraordinary. description: Hack With GDG S4 is the fourth season of the flagship hackathon organized by Google Developer Groups – KSR College of Engineering (GDG KSRCE) . The event brings together developers, designers, innovators, and problem-solvers to transform ideas into impactful solutions through technology. title: DSH Hacks V2 ($100k+ in prizes!)
description: DSH Hacks V2 is a global student competition open to students aged 13+ hosted collaboratively by three youth-led organizations: DeltaForge Hacks, NXT Horizon, and STEMise. Theme: AI x Healthcare This event brings together young innovators from around the world to transform bold ideas into technical products that address the health challenges facing our world today. Participants will work individually or in teams to identify a real-world healthcare problem and design and develop a meaningful technical solution. Projects may range from diagnostic tools tackling global disease burdens, to patient-care platforms improving access and outcomes, to AI-powered systems reimagining how we detect, treat, and manage illness. Creativity, feasibility, technical depth, clinical insight, and real-world impact will be central to evaluation. The theme of this competition is to build technical solutions that solve pressing healthcare problems. These solutions can be an app, a website, a simulation, a system, or an algorithm. Participants are encouraged to use AI to help them build a meaningful solution and to lower the technical barrier that poses challenges for beginners with ambitious project ideas.

title: Lean In Hacks 8.0
description: Lean In Hacks is an annual flagship hackathon of Lean In IGDTUW - the first chapter of Lean In India. Lean In Hacks is a beginner-friendly hackathon and has a place for everyone wanting to learn, build, share, and grow in their lives through their unique ideas. Our hackathon journey started in 2020 when we conducted the first edition of Lean In Hacks to give grounds to new thoughts and tools to animate the imaginative and critical thinking side of developers. This time, hackers from any college can participate in our hackathon, which will be held in hybrid mode . The only requirement is to have at least 1 female in your team ! Hackers will be given the weekend to build their product online and the top teams will be given a chance to pitch in the offline mode . As a beginner-friendly hackathon, we offer a dedicated Beginner’s Track exclusively for first-time hackers. This track is designed as an ideathon for first-year students , aimed at fostering innovative thinking, creativity, and confidence in problem-solving. title: PayPal AI Hackathon
description: About the challenge PayPal already moves money for millions of people and businesses, every day, all over the world. This hackathon is us opening that platform up and asking what happens when you put AI behind the wheel. New agents, new ways to pay and get paid, tools nobody's built yet. We want to see what you make of it. AI is changing how people build, buy, sell, work, connect, and move money. Now it's your turn to imagine what comes next. Build What's Next with PayPal and AI is a global online hackathon inviting developers, designers, founders, students, and builders to create something new using PayPal and AI . There are no prescribed problem statements and no set of tracks. Build an agent, an app, an automation, a new payment experience, a business tool, a social product, or something we haven't thought of yet. The only fundamental requirement: your project must meaningfully use both PayPal and AI . Why Join? Build something ambitious — Turn an idea into a working project using PayPal and AI. Explore what’s next — Experiment with new ways people, businesses, and AI agents can interact with money and payments. Win part of $ 69,750 in total prizes — Compete for overall prizes and special awards across creativity, impact, execution, and more. Show what you can build — Put your project in front of PayPal judges, developers, and the wider hackathon community. Learn by building — Explore PayPal APIs, AI tools, agents, automations, and emerging development workflows. Build your way — Join individually or as a team, and start something new or meaningfully advance an existing project. title: Learn AR with SPECS
description: Design an augmented reality app for glasses, and let an AI coding agent build it in Lens Studio. You don't need the glasses, because everything runs in Lens Studio's preview on your laptop. You'll get a short concept video, a skill pack for your coding agent, a live build session, and a live project review. $2,500 in prizes each round. ABOUT THE CHALLENGE Screens won't be the only place we use computers. Glasses are coming, and building for them is different from building for a laptop or a phone. Most first tries at AR end up as a website floating in front of your face. Good AR does things a laptop can't do: It shares your view. The camera sees what you see, so the app can respond to it. It draws in the world. Content sits on the table, over the stove, at real size, right where it belongs. It leaves your body free. Your hands stay available and your eyes stay up, so you can keep doing the real thing. Coding agents can now build a working Lens from a good description. So the hard part is deciding what's worth building and how it should feel. That's what this hackathon teaches. You'll install our Devpost Learn skill pack in your coding agent. It interviews you about your idea, checks it against AR design best practices, and writes a design brief. Then Snap's CLAD agents build the Lens in Lens Studio from that brief, and you try it in the preview. You'll finish with a working Lens, the plan behind it, and a way of thinking about AR you can use on every project after this one. WHY JOIN Learn what makes a good AR app, from the design decisions an agent can't make for you. Build for SPECS, Snap's AR glasses, without owning a pair. Try Snap's newest agent tools: CLAD, the Lens Studio MCP, and LEAF testing. Get help from real people in a live build session and a live project review. Compete to win a share of $2,500. First place takes $1,250, and every winner gets a feature in the Devpost newsletter and on Devpost's socials. Everyone who submits an eligible project gets a Devpost Learn badge and a special role in the Devpost Discord. GET STARTED You'll need a computer that runs Lens Studio, Node.js and Git, and a coding agent that supports skills. Set up your tools with the quick start on the Resources tab: your coding agent, Lens Studio, the Lens Studio MCP, and the CLAD plugin. Can't sign in to the developer platform on Lens Studio 5.24? Use Lens Studio 5.23.2 instead. Watch the concept video (at the top of this page). It's short, and it covers the design ideas the judges look for. Install the skill pack: npx skills add challengepost/learn-specs --all -y. Then open your coding agent and say "Run the plan-lens skill." It takes it from there. Join the SPECS channel in the Devpost Discord for questions and to see what other builders are making. Register for the Build for SPECS: AR Design with Lens Studio and CLAD live build session on Thursday, Oct 29 at 12PM ET. We build a Lens start to finish. It's recorded if you can't make it. Come to the SPECS Live Review: Inside the Judging Criteria on Thursday, Nov 5 at 12PM ET. We review a few projects in progress against the judging criteria, so you still have time to act on the feedback before the deadline. Want yours reviewed live? Post it in the #devpost-learn-feedback channel in the Discord and tag it "Learn AR with SPECS" and "Will It Ship." Stuck? Ask in the Discord channel. Setup help, the FAQ, and event details are on the Resources tab.

title: UGREEN Hackathon 2026 on AI NAS
description: UGREEN is opening AI NAS to developers through UGOS and Skills Hub . Powered by UGOS , UGREEN's own Linux-based operating system, UGREEN AI NAS brings local storage, computing, and AI capabilities together in one platform. UGOS makes it easy to keep your data secure, find and organize your files, and get more done with AI. With the UGOS Skill Creation Tool and your preferred AI assistant, you can create custom Skills that use supported NAS capabilities to organize files, find information, and automate everyday tasks. UGREEN Skills Hub gives developers the freedom to explore new ideas, create innovative tools, and expand what AI NAS can do. You bring the ideas. We'll help you build them. Access developer resources and technical support, with opportunities to win prizes, gain exposure through UGREEN, and explore future collaborations. No UGREEN NAS is required to enter. Finalists will receive free access to a UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro environment for final development, testing, and validation. The Hackathon has two rounds: Round 1 (open to all): Share your idea and an early build of your Skill. You do not need a NAS to enter. Download the UGREEN Skill Developer Package. Then submit a short PDF and a Pre-test Skill Package (ZIP). Round 2 (Finalists only): UGREEN will select up to 30 Finalists. Each Finalist gets one assigned testing day of free remote access to a real UGREEN AI NAS to install, test, and polish their Skill. Finalists then submit their final Skill and a short demo video to compete for $46,000 in cash prizes! Get Started: 🧠 Get to know UGREEN AI NAS . Learn what it can do. 💬 Join the UGREEN Community . It's a place to find teammates, compare approaches, and get help when you're stuck, while keeping up with official Hackathon news and development resources and discovering community perks. ✨ 📦 Download the UGREEN Skill Developer Package . It has the tools and technical docs you need. You must use this package to build your Skill. 🛠️ Brush up on helpful skills . Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, Linux and Docker, AI agent and tool design, and file or media processing are all useful here. Why Participate 💰 Compete for $46,000 in cash prizes. Five winners will share the prize pool, including two Most Creative awards. 🚀 No NAS needed to start. Round 1 is open to everyone. You only need your idea, the Skill Developer Package, and your code . 🖥️ Test on real hardware for free. Each Finalist gets one assigned testing day of free remote access to a UGREEN AI NAS iDX6011 Pro. 🎨 Build what you care about. Choose from four tracks: work automation, personal memories, creative media, or your own original idea. 🤝 Connect with the UGREEN team. Access developer resources and technical support, with opportunities to win prizes, gain exposure through UGREEN, and explore future collaborations .

title: Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon
description: Twitch is the home of shared live experiences, and developers shape how streamers and their communities experience them. OpenAI and Twitch are teaming up to see what developers can build for the Twitch community with AI. In the Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon, you'll use OpenAI Codex to build useful and creative experiences for Twitch streamers and their community. Give chat a way to play along, help streamers create together, or add something new to enhance the content they stream. You’ll leave with a working project and hands-on experience building with Codex. The top 5 projects will be showcased on the Codex Booth stage at TwitchCon San Diego on November 15, where winners will be announced live. Why join? $25,000 in prizes , and a spot on the TwitchCon stage for the top 5 Build with Codex : tell Codex what you're building and let it help you get set up with the Twitch API, EventSub and chat Connect streamers and their community : build something streamers and viewers can use live on stream Get started Sign in to Codex and start a new thread for your project. You’ll need its session ID when you submit. Find everything you need to build at dev.twitch.tv . Not sure where to start? Get a chatbot running in minutes with the Example Chatbot guide Join the TwitchDev Discord and ask questions in the channel that fits what you're building. Say hi in #codex-twitchcon-hackathon channel for general questions and updates.

title: Codegeist 2026: Build with context. Ship with confidence.
description: What is Codegeist? Codegeist is Atlassian’s annual hackathon where developers from around the world unleash creativity on Forge, Atlassian’s serverless app development platform. By extending Atlassian products with custom apps and integrations, participants reimagine how teams plan, track, and deliver work. The Challenge AI can think. But knowing what to do – really knowing – takes context. Atlassian’s Teamwork Graph connects goals, work, people, decisions, and outcomes like associative memory for your organization, giving teams the shared understanding of who’s doing what, what’s already been decided, and what needs to happen next. That's the problem Atlassian is built to solve. And it's the problem we're inviting you to tackle. Build an app on Atlassian’s Forge platform that uses that context to help teams ship with confidence – whether that’s surfacing the right knowledge at the right moment, connecting work across silos, or turning organizational data into a decision that actually moves work forward.

title: Kiroween 2026
description: 🎃 Kiroween 2026 is open for hacking👻 Kiro’s annual Halloween-themed hackathon has returned, and building starts now. Last year, thousands of developers used Kiro to bring dead tech back to life, stitch together unexpected technologies, and create hauntingly good experiences. This year, it’s your turn. Show us how you use Kiro to push boundaries. Work across a crew of agents in Kiro Crew, add structure with specs, customize workflows with hooks or steering, streamline with Kiro powers, or bring in new capabilities with MCP. Pick a category, build something wicked, and compete for $100,000 in prizes. You have until Friday, December 4, 2026 at 2:00 PM Pacific Time to submit. Only new projects are eligible . You must build your project during the Submission Period (October 30 to December 4, 2026). Projects you started before October 30, including Kiroween 2025 projects, are not eligible. Get started Read the Official Rules . Review them before you start to build. Get free Kiro credits . Request 4,000 free Kiro credits on the Resources tab by December 1 at 12:00 pm PT. Find details on the Resources tab . Join the Kiro Discord . Get help from the Kiro team, Kiro ambassadors, and other participants in #kiroween-hackathon. You’ll also find biweekly office hours and other live events to help you along the way. Find your teammates . Browse the Participants tab (optional). Teams can have up to three members. Join the Devpost Build Session on November 11 at 10:00 AM PT. Sign up coming soon . Start your submission early . Click “Enter a Submission” and save drafts as often as you like.

title: Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026
description: THE META VR START DEVELOPER COMPETITION IS BACK! This year’s eight-week challenge calls on Start program members to build the next generation of Entertainment, Gaming, and Productivity experiences for Meta VR devices – including Meta VR Glasses and Meta Quest. We’re looking for hands-first apps that make interaction more natural and gameplay more intuitive than ever before. Last year, over 2,900 developers joined the competition and delivered more than 650 submissions that pushed the boundaries of immersive technology. This year, we’re raising the bar again. Whether you’re a first-time Start developer with a breakthrough idea or a seasoned creator ready to showcase what’s possible with the latest platform capabilities, this is your moment to help redefine the future of VR. Here’s what’s waiting for you: 🤝 Build hands-first. Design experiences powered by hand interactions that feel natural, responsive, and deeply immersive—no controllers required. 🛠️ Explore new tech. Take advantage of the latest OS capabilities and device features across Meta VR Glasses and Meta Quest, accelerate your development with AI tooling, including Meta VR CLI. 🌍 Join a global community. Boost your skills through mentor programming, collaborate with fellow developers, share insights, and learn from a thriving network of experienced VR developers. 🏆 Compete for $1M in cash prizes with top prizes of $100,000. The future of VR is in your hands literally . We can’t wait to see what you build. GETTING STARTED If you’re not already a member of the Start program, apply now to join the competition. title: YouCam API Skin AI & eCommerce VTO Hackathon
description: Unleash Your Innovation: Shape the Future of Skincare and eCommerce. Calling all builders, creators, and visionaries: it’s time to completely reimagine the way we shop. The YouCam API Skin AI & eCommerce VTO Hackathon is your launchpad. We’re unlocking our most advanced, market-tested AI and AR infrastructure just for you. It's time to build the real-world, scalable products, including cutting-edge Agentic AI workflows. We’re challenging you to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Seamlessly integrate YouCam APIs into your wildest ideas, whether that means engineering a self-learning styling assistant, a hyper-personalized skin analysis tool, or an entirely new solution to everyday consumer pain points. Bring your boldest concepts to the table, and we’ll back your vision with serious prize money. Are you up for the challenge? 🎉 🎉 Share & Earn Bonus: Share your hackathon project and earn bonus API units! click HERE About the challenge All solutions must integrate at least one [ YouCam API ] into a functional web or mobile prototype that delivers clear consumer value. We want fresh, unexpected solutions to real-world pain points in beauty, fashion, or eCommerce—not surface-level wrappers. You can even take it a step further by building scalable products that include cutting-edge Agentic AI workflows. Pick the topic that best fits your vision and submit: Skin AI: People don't wonder about their skin in the abstract; they wonder right before a purchase, right after a bad breakout, or right when they're standing in front of a mirror deciding whether a product is working. Build something that meets that moment. Use YouCam's Skin AI, alone or combined with other YouCam APIs, to help users understand their skin and know exactly what to do next. eCommerce VTO: Beauty and fashion decisions rarely happen in isolation; what someone wears and how their looks are part of the same self-image. Build something that brings Virtual Try-On together into one seamless, intuitive experience. We want to see what's possible when both capabilities work as one to reimagine the way we shop. Why Join Build with YouCam API. Access AI Skin Analysis and generative Apparel Virtual Try-On, the same models powering 800+ global beauty and fashion brands, on a standard REST API that drops into any stack. Get free API units to build , deploy, and demo. Every registered participant receives 1,000 free API units just for signing up. Win cash , API credits , and real visibility . Click here to sign up and verify your email. (2 minutes) Claim Your Free 1,000 YouCam API Units. Click here and go to Account > Redeem Code > Enter the redeem code (3 minutes) 1,000 API Units will be added to your account immediately.
